title: Service request procedure for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services not accepted by the network

entities.name: Service request procedure for initiating PDN connection for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish PDN connection for emergency bearer services when network does not accept the request.

entities.name: Service request procedure completion
entities.description: Procedures described in clause 5.6.1.5 that UE performs when emergency service request is not accepted.

entities.name: Service request procedure abnormal cases
entities.description: Procedures described in clause 5.6.1.6 that UE performs when emergency service request fails due to abnormal cases.

entities.name: UE in same selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE remains in the same PLMN where the last service request was attempted.

entities.name: Inform upper layers of procedure failure
entities.description: UE action to notify upper layers about the failure of the emergency service request procedure.

entities.name: Local detach and EPS attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: UE action to perform local detach (if not already detached) and attempt EPS attach specifically for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: Abnormal case a from clause 5.6.1.6
entities.description: Specific abnormal case condition causing service request failure for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: Abnormal cases b, c, or e from clause 5.6.1.6
entities.description: Set of abnormal case conditions causing service request failure for emergency bearer services.

relations.description: UE performs procedures from clause 5.6.1.5 when emergency service request is not accepted.
UE performs procedures from clause 5.6.1.6 when emergency service request fails due to abnormal cases.
UE actions are conditional on being in the same PLMN where last service request was attempted.
When UE is in same PLMN, it informs upper layers of procedure failure.
When UE is in same PLMN, it performs local detach and EPS attach for emergency services.
When service request fails due to abnormal case a, UE informs upper layers of network access failure.
When service request fails due to abnormal cases b, c, or e, UE performs procedures from clause 5.6.1.6.
